# Trebell

> Trebell is a founder-led developer-tools startup building software and infrastructure for AI-assisted software engineering.

## Flagship product: Trebell Code

Trebell Code is developed and maintained by Trebell and is the company's primary product.

- Company product overview: https://trebell.dev/product/
- Product website: https://code.trebell.dev/
- Current release: 2.0.0
- Platform: Windows 10 and 11 (x64)
- Download (starts the installer download): https://github.com/tanishqbaweja/trebellcode-releases/releases/download/v2.0.0/Trebell-Code-Setup-2.0.0.exe
- Release notes: https://github.com/tanishqbaweja/trebellcode-releases/releases/tag/v2.0.0
- Price: free to download and use
- Licensing and releases: https://trebell.dev/licensing/
- Category: desktop workspace for AI coding agents

Trebell Code is a desktop coding workspace around coding agents: files, terminal, Git and pull requests, worktrees, previews, a browser panel, projects and environments. Trebell Native is Trebell's own agent harness, with its own model and tool loop calling model APIs directly; OpenAI is its default provider. Trebell Code also runs Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode (1.x and OpenCode 2), Cursor, Grok Build, Antigravity and Muse Code (new in 2.0) as their real harnesses, each with its own models, sign-in, approvals and updates, so developers are not forced to rebuild their workflow around a single model vendor.

## Business model

- Pricing and business model: https://trebell.dev/pricing/
- Trebell Code is free to download and use, with no software license fee.
- Trebell's planned commercial layer is team infrastructure: organization policy, shared usage and cost controls, managed execution environments, auditability, and administration.
- Team pricing has not yet been announced.

## Website data practices

The current public Trebell marketing site does not include analytics, advertising trackers, account registration, or contact forms. Theme controls on some pages may store a preference in browser local storage. Hosting/network providers and externally hosted fonts may process ordinary request metadata required to deliver those resources.

## What Trebell measures

Trebell evaluates coding-harness performance using resolved software-engineering tasks graded by an independent verifier, and API-equivalent dollar cost. Benchmark claims are presented with task/result context and should be read together with the benchmark evidence on the Trebell Code product site: https://code.trebell.dev/#proof
